title: Add Captain and Mechanicum Priest vox communications
outcome: The Captain and Mechanicum Priest proactively explain actual colony conditions through concise portrait-led vox messages, with each officer covering distinct responsibilities.
scope: Captain: available housing or berths, food and water reserves, and crew-facing consequences
Mechanicum Priest: actual production or input shortages, construction supply needs, completed research, and newly charted discoveries
Original portraits and visually distinct voices, shared nonmodal vox card and a bounded session transcript
Read existing colony metrics, research completion, and survey events; use simulation-time sampling, sustained thresholds, severity and deduplication
nonGoals: Voice acting, animated characters, branching dialogue, rewards, new simulation mechanics, or changes to save schema
Pause the game, open a modal, or reveal unsurveyed content
acceptance: Controlled housing pressure and crew resource shortage produce correctly attributed Captain messages with a clear reason and practical next step
A sustained manufacturing bottleneck, research completion and a new survey finding are attributed to the Priest and reflect verified game state
Messages show the matching portrait and readable speaker name; ordinary reports never capture camera input or interrupt decisions
A single condition does not repeatedly notify on threshold oscillation, fast-forward, or load; existing colonies and new landings start cleanly
Existing simulation checks pass and Unity Play Mode verifies UI, pause/speed, scenario triggers, input focus and save/reload behavior
rollback: Remove the observer and vox presentation wiring, leaving all simulation and saved colony state intact.

design.reference: Issue #25 design review: use real simulation data and explicit research/survey notifications, bound and deduplicate messages, preserve all save formats, and use the shared UI card.

rework.reason: Revalidate the extended scene fixture against updated main.
Separate the approved vox integration from the ongoing UI overhaul.

review.reference: Independent review verified the Vox-only diff against main and preserved existing menu behavior outside Vox Log and its Research hit area. The GitHub candidate and local reviewed candidate have identical trees.

validation.tester: Coordinating GPT-6.1 Sol using the Vox Scene Test Agent fixture
validation.reference: 606 .NET checks and 25 Unity Play Mode checks passed on the standalone scope.
